content: {"question":"If I move from France to New Zealand, how will my life insurance coverage change?","answer":"In France you can designate beneficiaries through the Generali portal, while in New Zealand GitLab does not provide life‑insurance benefits and employees rely on government payments or personal arrangements.","evidence_a":"1. Visit the [Generali beneficiary designation portal](https://designation-beneficiaires.generali.fr/)","evidence_b":"GitLab does not plan at this time to offer Life Insurance benefits because New Zealanders can access [government payments and services](https://www.workandincome.govt.nz/providers/health-and-disability/helping-people-into-work/index.html) to help if they get ill, injured or have a disability."}
